subject.title: Add an "Approve and Run" action for assistant-suggested terminal commands in the Control UI

question: Should Control UI support assistant-suggested command execution, and if so what typed proposal/approval contract should own command text, cwd, host, risk labels, and output streaming?
rationale: The implementation would create a new assistant-output-to-local-command execution path, so the repo needs maintainer intent on security semantics and UX boundaries before a fix PR is safe.

options.title: Design typed command proposals first
options.body: Add the feature only after defining a structured command proposal and approval contract that reuses existing Gateway approval enforcement.

options.title: Keep assistant commands copy-only
options.body: Leave assistant-rendered shell blocks as copy-only UI until the command execution model has a stronger product/security need.

options.title: Fold into dashboard approval work
options.body: Let the pending approvals dashboard establish shared approval UX first, then add assistant command proposals as a follow-up surface.

recommendation.title: Design typed command proposals first
recommendation.body: Add the feature only after defining a structured command proposal and approval contract that reuses existing Gateway approval enforcement.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans exec approval contracts, approval security hardening, and current Control UI approval/chat surfaces.
